{218}$ is in the middle of the room at the
column $d(V_{218},\text{col})\approx 0$ looking $NE$ to
$W_{2}/W_{3}$, $d(V_{218},W_{4}) \approx 1/2\,H \approx
6-8$ floor modules.

The NEW view is a normal view $N\perp W_{4}$ to $W_{4}$,
$d(V_{NEW},W_{4}) \approx 3-4$ floor modules in front of
$W_{4}$.

$$d(V_{NEW},V_{005}) = |d(V_{NEW},W_{4})-d(V_{005},W_{4})| \approx 2-3$$
$$d(V_{NEW},V_{218}) = |d(V_{NEW},W_{4})-d(V_{218},W_{4})| \approx 4-6$$

$$d(V_{NEW},V_{005}) < d(V_{NEW},V_{218})$$

Answer: **005** - $V_{NEW}$ is the same $S$-side station as $V_{005}$,
turned $180^{\circ}$ to face $W_{4}$.
